sampling.method: Monotonic midpoint, left-held samples; missing intervals not zero-filled; sampled estimate, not physical utilization CI.

b0.scope: Synthetic C8 stress only. Warmups excluded from formal metrics. Formal throughput includes full drain in denominator; all formal requests in numerator. Window throughput counts only requests wholly inside each window, with crossings separate, not exact token-arrival throughput. Arrival-cohort latency includes drain; small-sample P99 retained. No five-dataset quality, fixed-arrival latency or business-cost acceptance inferred.
